responsibility: Declares ResolverBase, the common superclass for Rust AST resolution visitors in GCC. It ties the generic AST visitor interface to the Rust name-resolution subsystem by owning pointers to the global Resolver and Analysis::Mappings objects, carrying the current resolved NodeId result, and exposing shared helpers such as visibility resolution; all later AST resolver classes in this directory derive from it to traverse AST nodes against name, type, and label scopes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ResolverBase class itself, including its stored Resolver/Mappings pointers, resolved-node field, and the full visitor surface that specialized resolvers override. Unlike the matching .cc file, this header is the interface and state definition, not the default visitor and visibility-resolution implementation.
